scope: Independent finite source/design and official-documentation review only. No platform implementation, ABI construction, real file-port test, source-closure qualification, old-run replay or payload operation.

required_findings.source_basis: The referenced accepted source_key requires a drive-absolute path with at least4characters and rejects empty components after drive-prefix splitting. C:\ and D:\ are3characters and cannot pass it. The new ancestor index includes all directory ancestors of admitted originals/output parents, including those drive roots.
required_findings.effect: The design has no representable admitted metadata node for a required ancestor. A literal source_key reuse either rejects every otherwise valid drive path during ancestor construction or silently omits/normalizes a node outside the stated U census.
required_findings.minimal_required_correction: Define a distinct metadata-directory-node grammar that admits exact approved X:\ drive roots only when derived from the finite admitted ancestor index. Keep original/output file leaf grammar unchanged; no arbitrary root discovery or role expansion. Include each distinct root in U and its attributes call budget, retain canonical collision identity and directory/no-reparse/known-return requirements.
required_future_pure_vectors: Approved C:\ and D:\ ancestors admitted and each counted once
Drive-root spelling cannot be an original/output file leaf or scan-discovered new authority
Failed/unknown root attributes prevent ancestry completion without fallback or a hidden extra call
required_findings.author_response: Author independently confirmed the gap and proposed this exact directory-only correction. Frozen v1 remains unchanged; no implementation or correction was run.

documented_API_assessment.ownership: CreateFileW and FindFirstFileExW document INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE failure; unexpected null/zero remains unknown. CreateDirectoryW TRUE may establish namespace ownership only, while existing/failure/unknown cannot authorize writes. Known file/search handles belong in the registry before inspection/logging/clock checks.
documented_API_assessment.closers: File slots use CloseHandle; search slots use FindClose. The once-only close reservation and unknown/failure disposition are coherent. No unknown handle is guessed closed or retried.
documented_API_assessment.identity: Disk type, FileAttributeTagInfo9, normalized DOS final-path flags0 and same-handle size checks match the stated APIs. Failed buffers remain undefined. Success DWORD lengths and BOOL outputs need function-specific definedness, not a blanket LastError0 assumption.
documented_API_assessment.synchronous_IO: Read/write handles omit OVERLAPPED and supply count cells. Retain returned flag/raw count/known successful count and ownership before throwing postchecks; unsuccessful raw cells do not establish known bytes. Positive short operations are bounded; zero progress cannot loop indefinitely.
documented_API_assessment.search: First failed buffer is indeterminate; initial documented not-found handling is separate from a valid iterator's FindNext false/error18 natural end. FindNext order is not guaranteed. Retained API-order buffers and a separately sorted complete index are appropriate.
documented_API_assessment.publication: CREATE_NEW plus explicit flush/close/owner acknowledgment is a coherent prospective DAG. A written seal alone cannot attest its own close or final clock; missing/partial/failure markers and unknown required operations continue to veto. No post-hard-deadline API dispatch is authorized.

arithmetic_and_scope_checks.file_identity_and_close_API_term: 6*(N+F) matches one CreateFile,GetFileType,AttributeTagInfo,FinalPath,Size,Close attempt per prospective file slot.
arithmetic_and_scope_checks.journal_event_formula: 13 K pairs +7 fixed events +128 reserved headroom =161. With declared symbol ceilings N256,B16,M16,S16, E=1825<=2048; this is algebra, not admission of an actual roster or proof of time/memory fit.
arithmetic_and_scope_checks.search_buffers: Two scans with sumD<=16 and sumX<=178 require at most194 distinct592-byte buffers =114848bytes, preserving failed/late cells.
arithmetic_and_scope_checks.output_quota: 8MiB journal +four2MiB reports +four8192-byte small files =16809984bytes. Proposed sumWrite bound E+412 and Flush bound E+F are internally consistent conservative allowances; short/failing paths may exhaust them and remain incomplete.
arithmetic_and_scope_checks.full_plan: Exact future N/B/M/U/directories/roles/bytes/edges/events/API/capture/report admission is still required before remaining original opens. Existing bounds do not establish that a future real graph fits.
arithmetic_and_scope_checks.clock: The first source clock and same-origin continuation preserve300s/295s with5s finalization reserve. The design discloses interpreter prerequisites and lacks OS preemption guarantees. Bulk original reads/hash/capture cease at work cutoff; cleanup/publication is constrained by the unchanged hard cutoff.

author_clarifications_to_preserve_in_suc: Per-output API/write/flush/close observations are registry-only, not extra journal events outside the fixed stage/F_fixed budget. This avoids journal recursion and preserves the stated E admission formula.
A late known write may leave hashing pending. The prepared immutable record and known-written offset remain retained; no post-hard-cutoff hash completion or successful artifact pin is inferred.

The4096-unit path/buffer admission ceiling is not a claim that unprefixed DOS paths all work without the Windows long-path opt-in. Documented API failures remain negative; no new path-prefix fallback, registry probe or OS policy project is requested.
future_review_boundaries: Actual typed bindings/layout sizes/offsets and function-specific last-error capture need separately reviewed source/pure vectors before harmless live qualification.

Preallocated registry ownership must survive identity/deadline/journal/cleanup errors before port return; exact raw-to-wrapper ordering is an implementation obligation, not proven by this design review.
Actual bootstrap source/decision ports, closed captured-source loader, once-only handoff and production engine continuation remain unimplemented/unqualified.

Archive/report/resource/Unicode checkers and exact source-bound protocol/authority closure remain separate. File-port design consistency cannot qualify an old failed profile or a future native experiment.
